score_0: one or more indispensable declared components absent or mutually incompatible
score_1: garment family partly recognizable but multiple required components absent or confused
score_2: all indispensable components present with one minor mismatch or unresolved view
score_3: all profile-required components present and mutually consistent across documented views
required_evidence: profile component checklist plus front side and back views or inspectable mesh
missing_evidence_rule: Mark NA and escalate when the profile has no sourced component checklist

score_0: declared garment family not recognizable or key proportions contradict the reference
score_1: family recognizable but two or more major proportion relationships conflict
score_2: major relationships agree; one localized proportion remains uncertain or mismatched
score_3: declared length width opening sleeve and layering relationships agree with the sourced reference
required_evidence: scaled orthographic views or mesh measurements plus sourced proportion ranges
missing_evidence_rule: Mark NA when scale or comparable views are unavailable

score_0: non-manifold or disconnected construction prevents a plausible garment assembly
score_1: major panel seam or closure conflict would require redesign
score_2: assembly is plausible with a minor seam panel or closure ambiguity
score_3: panels seams closures and layering form a documented sewable construction
required_evidence: pattern or panel topology; seam graph; closure record; maker review for heritage construction
missing_evidence_rule: Do not infer score 3 from renders alone

score_0: material behavior is physically impossible or contradicts the declared material
score_1: coarse visual resemblance but stiffness thickness transparency or fold behavior conflicts
score_2: material behavior is broadly plausible with one unresolved property
score_3: declared fibre/weave and observed stiffness thickness transparency and drape agree with reference evidence
required_evidence: material metadata plus multi-view render or simulation settings and sourced textile reference
missing_evidence_rule: Mark NA when material metadata and diagnostic views are absent

score_0: motif family placement orientation or combination contradicts the sourced profile
score_1: generic or partly relevant motif with major placement scale or orientation uncertainty
score_2: motif family and placement are broadly supported with one localized uncertainty
score_3: motif identity scale orientation placement technique and combination agree with object-level evidence
required_evidence: high-resolution texture and UV/placement record plus object-level motif source
missing_evidence_rule: Mark NA for unsourced broad ethnic labels; never substitute visual similarity

score_0: one or more dated regional claims directly conflict or are anachronistic
score_1: region or period is declared but major evidence is missing or mixed
score_2: most components support the declared region and period with one unresolved field
score_3: all scored components motifs materials and metadata are mutually consistent with dated regional sources
required_evidence: region period source identifiers and claim-evidence links
missing_evidence_rule: Missing provenance cannot receive score 2 or 3

score_0: declared use is contradicted by sourced restrictions or required ensemble elements are absent
score_1: context is named but unsupported or materially incomplete
score_2: context is plausible and most required ensemble information is present
score_3: use wearer occasion ensemble and manner of wearing agree with object-level and specialist/community evidence
required_evidence: context record ensemble views source identifiers and specialist/community assessment
missing_evidence_rule: No public-facing approval without specialist or community review
